en: The image depicts a black-and-white scene of three men browsing a large stand of postcards outdoors. The stand displays many racks of colorful postcards featuring various images, likely landmarks and cultural motifs. Behind the stand is a building with the sign 'MUNICIPAL INFORMATION OFFICE' and some text in Hebrew. There are other people visible in the background, including a woman smoking.
